items.title: Design review of proposed 1280-1330 Boylston Street development in Chestnut Hill
items.summary: City Realty will present plans for three new buildings along Route 9 and Heath Street, including two 12-story mixed-use buildings with retail, hotel, condos, medical offices and apartments, plus a 7-story apartment building. Residents can ask questions and comment on the design at this virtual Zoom meeting.
